products.title: James Hoffmann Fermentation Project
products.body_html:
After coffee cherries are plucked from the tree, but before the green seeds are spread out in the sun to dry, what happens? Fermentation occurs, where the seeds are removed from the cherry, then exposed to a combination of heat, moisture, and all kinds of micro-organisms as the sugary mucilage on the outside of the bean is stripped away. Even for roasters, the impact of fermentation on flavor and quality is still a bit of a mystery.

With the James Hoffmann Fermentation Project set, we intend to pull back the curtain on this process.

A collaboration with Hoffmann, a celebrated industry professional; Lucia Solis, a coffee scientist and consultant; and dozens of other eager roasters, this set contains coffee from Finca San Miguel Urias in Antigua, Guatemala that was processed in four distinct ways at origin.

  1. Mechanically Demucilaged; removing the sugary, goopy layer on the outside of the seed (mucilage) by applying water and machine-created friction.

  2. Wild Fermentation; breaking down the mucilage by soaking the coffee in a tank with the local environment’s naturally occurring microorganisms.

  3. Lactobacillus Inoculated; breaking down the mucilage  with a concentration of Lactobacillus bacteria added into the tank.

  4. Yeast Inoculated; breaking down and removing the mucilage with a concentration of Yeast added into the tank.

On our end, we’re taking  a uniform approach to roast duration, development time, and roast level in order to highlight the processing variable. We’ll also walk you through a modified cupping protocol that you can follow along with using the tools you have at Join likeminded enthusiasts in a virtual global cupping event on October 3rd, or simply taste each coffee in your own time. Every set will ship with tasting instructions so that you can focus on flavor without worrying about the method. A link to the virtual global cupping will be provided when your coffee ships.

Opportunities to taste the varying results of different fermentation techniques are few and far between. You will gain special insight and a deeper appreciation for a producer’s role in the production of coffee.

The James Hoffmann Fermentation Project is a limited-availability set of four 4oz coffee bags. They are limited to one set per customer, whole bean only, and are available now as a pre-order while supplies last.

This product is excluded from any promotional sales or discounts. Your set will ship on September 11th. Please note that any additional coffee added to your pre-order of a Fermentation Project set will ship on September 11th as well. Thank you for your understanding.

products.title: Justice
products.body_html: Higher Grounds’ version of a Breakfast Blend. Justice Blend, our most popular light roast, combines the nuttiness of Guatemalan beans with the zip of Ethiopian. We love the notes of smooth vanilla sweetness, balancing out the citrusy brightness.  The perfect cup to wake you up.

products.title: Funky Mamacita
products.body_html:
A hint of roasted nuts complemented by sweet earthy undertones in a smooth, bold cup. Honduran and Peruvian beans come together in a crowd-pleasing medium-dark roast.

Funky Mamacita represents the spirit of Higher Grounds, a spark and energy that ignites our passion for gender equity in the world of specialty coffee. It's spirited name is an homage to the first HG employee to have a baby while employed at Higher Grounds.

products.title: Trio Gift Set | Coffee Sampler
products.body_html:
Each Trio Gift Set brings together three intentionally selected coffees that highlight how origin, roast level, and processing shape flavor. Designed for gifting, home cupping, and flavor exploration, with three roaster-curated 6oz bags per set.

  • Signature Trio to try our most popular blends
  • Origin Trio for single-origin selections
  • Apex Trio for our premier offerings

(Scroll for details on each offering) 

 

Signature Trio Gift Set
Our three best-selling blends speak for themselves. Carefully designed to balance layers of flavor with unparalleled consistency.

  • Highland Humanity: Medium-dark roast with bold notes of caramel, cocoa, and balanced sweetness.

  • Funky Mamacita: Medium-dark roast with earth, roasted nuts, and bold depth; Honduran and Peruvian coffees create a smooth, nutty, gently earthy cup.

  • Justice: Light-medium roast with vanilla, citrus, and mellow brightness; Guatemalan nuttiness balanced by Ethiopian citrus zip.

 

Origin Trio Gift Set
Three single-origin coffees from three regions, each offering a distinct taste of place.

  • Guatemala San Marcos: Medium roast with caramelized sugar sweetness, subtle florals, and gentle earthy undertones.

  • Mexico Maya Vinic: Medium roast with warm cinnamon, roasted nuts, cocoa depth, and a balanced finish.

  • Sumatra Permata Gayo: Dark roast with earthy depth, deep grape notes, and mellow acidity.

 

Apex Trio Gift Set
Three exceptional coffees chosen for their vibrant, expressive character.

  • Cariño Blend: Medium-dark roast with black cherry, honey, and creamy sweetness; honey-processed components create a velvety, fruit-forward profile that shines straight or in milk.

  • Colombia Fondo Paez: Light roast with shortbread sweetness, chamomile aromatics, and sugared grapefruit brightness.

  • Ethiopia Yirgacheffe: Light roast with citrus, bergamot, and black tea notes; smooth and layered with gentle stone fruit complexity.

 

Sets Include: Three 6-oz bags • Whole bean or ground • Roasted fresh in small batches

Explore the nuances and flavor landscapes created when long-practiced cooperative farming meets exceptional craft roasting.

Each set offers a guided taste across distinct profiles, showing just how vibrant, expressive, and diverse great coffee can be. A fun, curated, and educational way to experience the craft of coffee.

products.title: Donate-A-Bag  |  Community Support Coffee
products.body_html:
Support local food security, warming shelters, and community meals, one bag at a time. Donate a bag of coffee directly.

Higher Grounds has provided coffee to several frontline organizations for years. Recently, the need has grown. Staff, volunteers, and guests rely on coffee not just for warmth, but for comfort, dignity, and connection.

Now you can join us in supporting these essential community spaces.

Where Your Donation Goes

Your donated coffee is delivered directly to food security organizations, like our long-standing partners:

  • Food Rescue of Northwest Michigan – Working in partnership with the food pantries and community meal sites of the Northwest Food Coalition. https://www.goodwillnmi.org/food

  • Jubilee Outreach (Grace Episcopal) – A day shelter, food pantry, and community meals. https://gracejubileeoutreach.org/

  • Safe Harbor – A year-round non-profit, volunteer-run Emergency Shelter and Housing & Human Services Resource Center. https://www.gtsafeharbor.org/

How It Works

  • Choose a bag below, each offered at our cost, with no shipping required.

  • Add it to your cart alone or alongside your own order.

  • We handle delivery directly to our partner organizations.

Donation Options

  • 1lb Bag: $8

  • 3lb Bag: $22

  • 5lb Bag: $35

Your contribution helps keep these community partners stocked with the coffee they depend on every day.
